source_note: Tough Temple's official homepage (https://www.toughtemple.com/) links this Webflow stylesheet. Its :root tokens define --crimson:#DF2F4E, --midnight-blue:#0B1634, --black:#000B27, --text-colour:#06090A, and --white-text-colour:#FAFAFA. #DF2F4E is also used by .hero-button-2 and .register-btn.
